content.comment_body: I have the old [product_name] [version_no] on a disk. I can install it on an older PC with Windows 2000, but it's not possible to upgrade to a newer version. Is there anyone who can assist me?
Hello, That is a very old version. As far as I know, upgrades start from [product_name] Comfort [version_no]. Regards,

Hi, If I recall correctly, it was the first software to allow programming a [product_name] on a PC. The programming method was quite similar to using the buttons directly on [product_name]. For this software, updates are not available; only [product_name] Soft Comfort can be updated, not [product_name] Soft. Therefore, you'll need to purchase [product_name] Soft Comfort. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulties updating from outdated versions of [product_name] Soft to newer releases due to compatibility issues and the absence of upgrade options for discontinued versions. The old software cannot be updated, so users are advised to purchase the newer software package as the only available solution.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to be able to upgrade the old [product_name] Soft [version_no] to a newer software version suitable for current needs.
